verdict.rationale: Morph has a documented API reference surface: endpoint docs, an OpenAI-compatible base URL with SDK snippets, and llms.txt and markdown docs. A community user also describes running a provided example in a morphllm.com playground. However, nothing shows an interactive "try it" API reference, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: an interactive in-docs API explorer, runnable examples embedded in the reference, a published OpenAPI spec, and first-party documentation of the playground.
